name: PT Natura City Developments Tbk
summary: PT Natura City Developments Tbk operates as a real estate company in Indonesia. It operates through the Real Estate and Non-Trade segments. The company engages in the planning activities, implementation, construction, and facilities and general contractors, which include development of residential and shophouses; sale and purchase of buildings, houses, and shophouses. It also offers trade, industry, agriculture, mining, construction, transportation, and urban/town management services. The company was formerly known as PT Sumber Jaya Adhiguna and changed its name to PT Natura City Developments Tbk in March 2018.
